$comment: FND-04 deliverable 2 / acceptance item 4. The PRD 34.9 error catalogue, transcribed row by row.
`retry` is the PRD's Retry COLUMN TEXT, verbatim. `retryable` is the boolean this ticket assigns
(sub-PRD D7: "the code identifiers are FND-03's enum; the HTTP status, retryable flag and
response schema are this ticket's"), derived by ONE rule applied to all seventeen rows:
retryable = false  when the Retry column is "No" or "No automatic retry"
retryable = true   otherwise — every other column value names a condition after which a
test/openapi/error-catalogue.test.ts RE-EXTRACTS the 34.9 table from docs/PRD.md and asserts
this fixture's `http`, `code` and `retry` match it row for row and in order, then asserts the
document's components.responses match this fixture, then asserts `code` order equals FND-03's
ENUM_REGISTRY.ErrorCode.values. The rule above is applied to the RE-EXTRACTED column, not to the
fixture's own copy, so the derivation is checked against the PRD rather than against itself.
PRD 34.3 also names 409 CLARIFICATION_ROUND_CLOSED. It is absent from this table and from
FND-03's registry, and is deliberately NOT added — see sub-PRD Q-F8 (escalated to the founder).
Note that HTTP status is not one-to-one with code: three codes are 400, two 403, two 409, two 429
and three 503. That is why the document also carries composite responses; the test asserts every
composite's members are drawn from this table and share its status.

rows.userAction: Check ID; same response for forbidden/other tenant
Reuse original body or new key
Replace indicated spans with anonymous placeholders
Wait, prepay or configure approved BYOK
Search remains available; retry when status recovers
Review freshness/official link or wait for recovery
